subject.title: Feature Request: Custom TUI Footer Fields for Cost/Balance/Rate Limit Status

question: Should persistent TUI footer customization be solved as core TUI config, a PluginStatusProvider-style SDK plus TUI render path, or kept out of the persistent footer for now?
rationale: The request crosses public config, persistent TUI rendering, provider usage/auth, and Plugin SDK boundaries; automation cannot safely choose the long-term product/API contract or credential/caching policy.

options.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
options.body: Approve the PluginStatusProvider-style direction, then add persistent TUI rendering, ordering, truncation, and provider-usage fields after the SDK shape is settled.

options.title: Core config template
options.body: Add a first-class `tui` footer template/config surface and accept the compatibility, docs, schema, and migration burden for that public config contract.

options.title: Keep existing usage surfaces
options.body: Keep `/status`, `/usage`, CLI status, and menu-bar usage as the supported quota/cost surfaces and close persistent footer customization as not planned.

recommendation.title: Plugin/API-first footer seam
recommendation.body: Approve the PluginStatusProvider-style direction, then add persistent TUI rendering, ordering, truncation, and provider-usage fields after the SDK shape is settled.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest history across provider usage, Plugin SDK boundaries, and related product scoping comments.
